products.name: OpenShell
products.tagline: Sandbox runtime for AI agents on Red Hat OpenShift AI
products.description: OpenShell provides isolated execution environments for autonomous AI agents, governed by declarative YAML policies. Agents can use files, tools, and credentials without unrestricted access to your infrastructure. Part of the Red Hat OpenShift AI platform.
products.requirements: Red Hat OpenShift AI 3.6 or later, or standalone on Linux / macOS (Apple Silicon) / Windows WSL 2 with Docker or Podman.
